label: SYNTHETIC DEMO technical testing catalogue — invented guidance

controls.testing: Call each endpoint without credentials in a test environment and confirm rejection.

controls.risk: Malformed input causes injection or crashes.
controls.testing: Review schema validation and submit boundary values in test.

controls.description: Sessions time out and cookies are protected.
controls.testing: Inspect cookie flags and idle/absolute timeout behaviour.

controls.description: Server-side checks on every object access.
controls.testing: Attempt cross-account object access with a second test user.

controls.description: Third-party components are inventoried and patched.
controls.testing: Review the dependency inventory against published advisories.
Compare host configuration to the baseline checklist.
Review patch reports for in-scope hosts.
Review tenant admin settings against vendor hardening guidance.
Confirm local login is disabled or protected by MFA.
Record firmware versions and compare to vendor advisories.

controls.description: Personal data flows are documented and minimised.
controls.testing: Walk through the data-flow diagram with the project team.

controls.risk: Real personal data in test environments.
controls.description: Test environments use masked or synthetic data.
Vendor access is approved, logged and time-bound.
controls.testing: Review the vendor access procedure and recent access logs.

controls.description: An independent assurance report has been reviewed.
controls.testing: Review the report scope, period and exceptions.
